item.title: Local councils allocated energy efficiency funding
item.description: County Councils in the Shannonside region have been allocated over €6 million in funding under the Energy Efficiency Retrofit Programme. It is part of a pot of €140 million that is on the way to local authorities under the scheme. Locally, Roscommon County Council is to receive €3.7 million, Longford €2.6 million while €700,000 is on the way to Leitrim County Council. item.title: Enterprise Minister meets fuel industry reps as prices rise at the pumps
item.description: A meeting between Enterprise Minister Peter Burke and fuel industry reps yesterday is being welcomed after prices rose at the pumps. Fuel companies say they’ll cooperate with the Competition and Consumer Protection Commission investigation into fuel pricing. The meeting was held after claims of price gouging due to the conflict in Iran. Independent Motoring Expert for Carzone Conor Faughnan is raising concern fuel prices spiralled sooner than usual: Advertisement

item.title: Special fundraiser in Ballaghaderreen to raise funds for new children's hospice
item.description: A special fundraiser will take place in Ballaghaderreen this evening in aid of the Sunflower Children's Hospice. Around 15 people will take part in a 'Wax, Shave and Dye' event at Creaton's Bar from 7pm. All proceeds will go towards building a children's hospice in the region. The Sunflower Children's Hospice is a state-of-the-art Mayo Roscommon Hospice project. Local man Joe Egan is one of those going under the razor. He says it's for a very worthy cause: Advertisement

item.description: Over €80,000 has been earmarked for agricultural shows across the Shannonside region. item.title: Local MEP calls on government to reimburse Irish citizens returning from UAE
item.description: A local MEP is calling on the Irish government to reimburse Irish citizens returning from Dubai and other parts of the UAE. Independent MEP Ciaran Mullooly says there has been an 'abject failure' to use an EU emergency support mechanism to get citizens out of the warzone. item.title: Over 60 water outages in Cloonfad over past 18 months
item.description: The Seanad has heard that there has been over 60 water outages in Cloonfad over the past 18 months. Fine Gael Senator Gareth Scahill made the revelation during a debate on Infrastructure with Minister Jack Chambers. Local businesses have previously raised concerns regarding the outages. Senator Scahill says the problem needs to be resolved: Advertisement

item.title: Longford book place in division four final
item.description: Longford booked a place in the hurling league division four final after a share of the spoils with Warwickshire. Longford raced into a seven point lead with points from Sean Tiernan, Niall Hawes, Reuben Murray and Matthew Hawes in Birmingham. Hawes found the Warwickshire net after 15 minutes. Warwickshire hit four points without reply before half-time, as Longford took a three point lead to the break, 1-4 to 0-4.
